name: DL (Tourist) Visa / E-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Entry must be for tourism (visa symbol DL); most nationalities can alternatively apply for an e-visa online.
DL visa and e-visa are valid for up to 90 days.

requirement_groups.name: Citizens of countries Vietnam unilaterally exempts from visas

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of countries Vietnam has unilaterally exempted from visa requirements may enter and stay for 45 days, with the possibility of an extension.

evidence_required.document: Valid passport (13+ months validity recommended for onward status changes)
E-visa application or consular visa (unless unilaterally visa-exempt)

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days (DL/e-visa) or 45 days (unilateral exemption, extendable)

sources.title: LuatVietnam (private legal database) -- consolidated text of Vietnam's Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners (Consolidated Document 30/VBHN-VPQH 2023): DL tourist and EV e-visa categories, up to 90 days, Article 9
Government Portal (chinhphu.vn) -- full text summary of Law 23/2023/QH15 amendments: unilaterally visa-exempt nationals granted 45 days' temporary residence, extendable

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). STATUS: DRAFT -- the 45-day unilateral-exemption figure is tier-1 (Government Portal, chinhphu.vn), but the base DL/e-visa 90-day figure and category definition are sourced only to LuatVietnam, a PRIVATE commercial legal-database company -- accurate reproductions of the law's article text in this session's experience, but NOT a government-run publisher, so graded tier-3 rather than tier-1 despite quoting article numbers directly. This distinction matters for Vietnam specifically since much of the detailed visa-category information in this build comes from such private legal databases (luatvietnam.vn, thuvienphapluat.vn, english.luatvietnam.vn) rather than genuine .gov.vn government sources -- flagged here and in every file that relies on them, to avoid the kind of domain-based over-crediting flagged for other countries earlier in this dataset (e.g. Serbia's welcometoserbia.gov.rs vs .org confusion).
